subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Artists used it to design walking tours.”?
options: An old hand-drawn map showed large trees that once lined a city street.
The student council decided to make a new map.
Some even brought their parents to see the trees.
Before the map, trees were part of the background.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「An old hand-drawn map showed large trees that once lined a city street.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The student council decided to make a new map.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some even brought their parents to see the trees.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Artists used it to design walking tours. Before the map, trees were part of the background.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Artists used it to design walking tours. Before the map, trees were part of the background.」，答案為「Before the map, trees were part of the background.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Before the map, trees were part of the background.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
